steps.label: Start buying the weekly summer items: Melon Pan at the Ginza Line Gate and Soothing Soba on Central Street (both through August)
Sell the last palace's loot at the Airsoft shop if you haven't yet
Buy the new books at the Central Street bookstore
Hang out with Ryuji — Chariot reaches rank 4
Rent 'Not-so-hot Betsy'
Watch 'Not-so-hot Betsy'
Explore Mementos and clear both pending requests; don't spend lock picks on locked chests
Collect every Stamp and all Flowers; spend them with Jose — raise the item buff to x6 first (Flowers don't carry over)
Fuse Angel + Cait Sith into Eligor and Apsaras + Succubus into Orobas, then Advanced Fusion into Flauros (pass on Tarukaja)
Talk to the Twins — Strength reaches rank 3
Farm Mementos money — 100,000 yen is needed this month, 250,000 is safe (Treasure Demons are common under Pollen Warning)
Leave with Councilor, Temperance, Chariot, Lovers, and Hierophant Personas for coming hang-outs
Answer the TV game show: 'Probation officers are unpaid'
Watch 'Not-so-hot Betsy' (5/12)

Call Kawakami — Temperance reaches rank 2
Answer the class question: 'The halo effect'

Talk to the girl in the booth at the Kichijoji entrance

Receive the request 'An Elderly's Meaning of Life'
Buy the Sunday drink in the Underground Walkway
Hang out with Yoshida — Sun reaches rank 2
Chalk throw again — no need to dodge yet
Receive the request 'Sadism Is Just a Sign of Love'

Use the Bio Nutrient on your plant
Talk to the Twins on Central Street — Maragi and Mabufu skill cards (1/13)
Answer the class question: 'The number of legs'
Save first, then play darts at the Penguin Sniper Lounge: invite Ann ('Just play like normal') or Yusuke ('Pretend like you are painting') — never Morgana
Get two teammates to Baton Pass rank 3 (bull's-eyes add Proficiency)
Solve the LeBlanc crossword: 'Conference'

Answer the class question: 'Controlling public thought'

Talk to the Twins — Strength reaches rank 4 (re-summon a Temperance Persona if Makami was used)
Buy Black Rocks at the Kichijoji crystal shop (skippable if money is tight)

Confirm the request 'An Elderly's Meaning of Life' by listening to the two men in a Kichijoji alley

Receive the request 'One who Bullies Bullies'

Hang out with Ann — Lovers reaches rank 7

Buy the Sunday-only Chunky Katsu at the Kichijoji fried-food shop (30 SP for 150 yen)
Hang out with Yoshida — Sun reaches rank 3
Answer the class question: 'Green' — Knowledge reaches rank 4
Visit the Student Council Room on the third floor, by the library

Read 'Wise Men's Words' on the metro
Answer the class question: 'Coins'
Receive the request 'Part-time Job, Full-time Hell'
Classroom chain: listen to Ann, talk to Mishima outside, find Nishiyama in the library, then report back to Ann
Call Kawakami — Temperance reaches rank 5
Read 'Wise Men's Words' during class
Follow the hat man's chain near the Velvet Room entrance: the homeless man up the big Shibuya staircase, then the back alley south of Big Bang Burger

Confirm the request 'One who Bullies Bullies' by listening to the students in front of school

Stock 8 Tin Clasps and 8 Silk Yarn (Yongen-Jaya second-hand shop if short)
Sell sooty clothes in Kichijoji if you're under 100,000 yen

Watch 'The Running Dead'

Watch 'The Running Dead' (6/12)

Fourth chalk throw — dodge it this time
Rent 'ICU'
Buy SP-recovery drinks and the weekly summer items
Hang out with Ryuji — Chariot reaches rank 6
Buy a Mega Fertilizer in Shinjuku
Add Shinjuku's two SP-drink vending machines to your rotation
Buy 'The Craft of Cinema' and 'Game Secrets' at the Shinjuku bookstore
Visit the bathhouse in Yongen-Jaya

Use the Mega Fertilizer on your plant — Kindness reaches rank 3
Solve the LeBlanc crossword: 'Currency'
Talk to the Cheerful Fortune Teller in Shinjuku

Answer the class question: 'A pope'

Answer the TV game show: 'Ordering food without money'
Speak with Chihaya in Shinjuku and buy her 100,000-yen stone
Buy a Yakisoba Pan at the school store — keep it for tomorrow's trade
Hang out with Ann — Lovers reaches rank 9 (becomes a relationship)
Call Kawakami — Temperance reaches rank 7
Read 'Game Secrets' in class — 'the technique' unlocks for retro games

Grab all three Will Seeds (grappling-hook points off the vault stairs, in the Laundering Room, and left-left at the fourth PIN panel)
PIN panels: 'Rich' 0102, 'Reap' 0931, 'Huge' 2319, 'Gold' 1841
Ignore the golden pay-doors — they're only shortcuts
Secure the Treasure route, then perform one execution for the Fusion Alarm achievement
Leave the palace with 150,000+ yen
Watch 'ICU'
Buy the Sunday drink in the Underground Walkway
Save first, then play darts at the Penguin Sniper Lounge: invite Makoto ('Take a deep breath'); reload until two more teammates reach Baton Pass rank 3

Buy the Sunday-only Chunky Katsu at the Kichijoji fried-food shop

Buy SP-recovery drinks and the weekly summer items

Answer the class question: 'Gold'
Rent 'Jail Break'

Call Kawakami — Temperance reaches rank 8
Receive the request 'A Teacher Maid To Suffer'
Hang out with Yusuke — Emperor reaches rank 3
Solve the LeBlanc crossword: 'Front'
Buy 'ABC of Crafting' at the Shinjuku bookstore
Speak with Chihaya — receive the request 'Ending the Boyfriend's Abuse'
